# KINGAI Security public facts
Canonical product: https://security.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business contact: vip@kingai.work
Public repository purpose: commercial and product information only.
Do not infer source code, architecture, detection algorithms, deployment internals, API internals, security implementation or private configuration from this repository.
Current positioning: approachable security product focused on understandable protection experiences, threat findings, quarantine/recovery and a broader cross-platform security direction.
Roadmap directions may include richer reputation signals, behavior-aware intelligence, managed security and wider device coverage. Roadmap is not a claim of current availability.
No claims are made here about revenue, customer counts, certifications, market share, signed OEM relationships or fundraising status.

中文：本公开仓只用于产品、品牌、商业、SEO/GEO 与合作介绍，不包含源码、架构、算法、安全实现、部署细节、内部 API 或私有配置。未来功能均属于路线方向，除非已正式发布并验证。
